evidence_items.explanation: The June capability snapshot documents repeated failures on a short sibling-counting problem in prominent models. It supports the elementary-error component, although this deliberately diagnostic task does not measure average workplace performance.

evidence_items.explanation: The researchers report substantial hallucination rates in commercial legal assistants on their test questions. They also report that these tools reduce errors relative to general-purpose GPT-4, which limits any inference that mitigation had achieved nothing.
